description: Search open remote job listings aggregated from many job boards and company career pages, deduplicated. Use eligibleFrom to keep only jobs open to applicants in a given country, and overlapWith to rank by working-hours overlap with the applicant's time zone. Reposts by other job aggregators are hidden by default. Returns title, company, location, salary, eligibility and the URL of the original posting (apply there).

eligibleFrom.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the applicant can legally work from, e.g. 'ES', 'BR', 'DE'

employerOfRecord.description: Only jobs hiring through an employer of record (hire from many countries)

fourDayWeek.description: Only jobs offering a four-day week

includeAggregatorReposts.description: Include reposts by other job aggregators (hidden by default)

minOverlapHours.description: With overlapWith: minimum overlapping working hours

overlapWith.description: Applicant time zone, IANA name ('Europe/Madrid') or UTC offset ('+02:00'); adds working-hours overlap

publishedAfter.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only jobs published on or after it

source.description: Only jobs from this source board name

visaSponsorship.description: Only jobs that say they sponsor visas

name: search_jobs
title: Search remote jobs
